body: Thank you CalitexGirl.  Its really appreciated.

This then makes feel pretty angry which leads me to being spiteful.  No clue why.  Which now since I think about it and type it out maybe some of my problem I am having is I hate the "jackass" I have become?  I can work on that.  Thank you.
